subject: Novapay — follow up: pricing & invoice estimate
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro / discovery — follow up & next steps

Hi Aisha — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- Key goals: reduce average latency on paid customer flows to <250ms, and cut inference cost per 1M tokens to under your $1,200 target for the fraud-detection pipeline.
- Expected volume (your estimate): 100M tokens/month now, with a burst profile up to 300M tokens during month-end reconciliation windows.
- Model profile: multimodal prompts + ~1.5k average sequence length for decisioning.

Can you confirm the rough target budget range for the next 12 months (e.g., $X–$Y / month) and whether you prefer a hosted or dedicated setup for the pilot? Once we have budget guardrails I can share an invoice-style estimate and a cost-model spreadsheet showing unit economics (cost/$ per 1M tokens) and recommended configs (batching, quantization).

Attached: simple example cost model we used in the call (xls). I�ll follow up with a tailored estimate by EOD tomorrow.

Cheers,
Sean
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
--
Redwood Inference | 555 Bryant St, San Francisco, CA

Subject: Re: Intro / discovery — follow up & next steps

Thanks Sean — that summary is perfect. Quick answers: 

- Budget range: pilot $8k–$12k/month; if pilot meets SLA and latency goals, go to $35k–$50k/month for production (12-month commitment).
- Deployment: prefer hosted for pilot, but dedicated for production (data isolation + predictable throughput).
- Volume: current production is ~90–110M tokens/month; expected growth to 250–300M in 6–9 months.

I�m attaching our internal cost target: we�re aiming for <= $1,000 / 1M tokens effective (including caching/batching benefits). Can you show an invoice estimate that hits that target or explain trade-offs?

Thanks — Aisha
Aisha Khan, Head of ML Engineering | Novapay
Attachment: novapay_cost_target_notes.pdf (doc, 12KB)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@novapay.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-02T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Novapay — invoice-style estimate and cost model (NB-4821)

Hi Aisha / Tom — attached is an invoice-style estimate and the tailored cost model we discussed. Highlights up front: 

- Pilot (hosted): approx $10,200 / month for ~100M tokens (effective $1,020 / 1M tokens) using our optimized batching + prefix caching profile. This assumes no heavy multimodal attachments in the pilot.
- Production (dedicated, reserved pool): approx $36,500 / month for 300M tokens (effective $1,083 / 1M tokens) but with much tighter latency SLOs and capacity guarantees. If we enable stronger KV caching and a quantized model variant, we can push effective cost toward $980–$1,000 / 1M tokens for your steady-state workload — tradeoffs are slightly higher cold-start latency for cache-miss paths.

Attachments: 
- Invoice-estimate-NB-4821-APR2028.pdf — line-item invoice mock (setup fee, reserved capacity, monthly token tiers).
- Novapay-pricing-1M-token-breakdown.xlsx — per-tier unit economics (batch size, tokens/min, GPU-hours, unit cost).
- novapay_cost_model_v2.csv — raw model inputs used to generate the spreadsheet.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Pilot SOW and signature for hosted pilot (2–4 weeks) — I can share draft SOW and PO wording.
2) Rishi to sync with your infra team to confirm quantization/compatibility and confirm any model variants we should test.
3) Procurement: we�ll need a PO and expected billing cadence (monthly vs quarterly).

Happy to hop on a quick call to walk the numbers; otherwise Monica will follow up with an SOW and a cleaned invoice PDF for procurement.

Thanks,
Sean
Attachment: Invoice-estimate-NB-4821-APR2028.pdf (pdf, 22KB); Novapay-pricing-1M-token-breakdown.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB); novapay_cost_model_v2.csv (csv, 6KB)

Hi Aisha — thanks for the details and for confirming budget ranges. Attached is a one-page hosted pilot SOW and a cleaned invoice PDF ready for procurement (Invoice-estimate-NB-4821-APR2028.pdf). Summary: 

- Pilot duration: up to 4 weeks (start on PO date), covers up to 120M tokens.
- Price: $10,200 (monthly pilot rate) billed monthly; pilot fees applied as credit toward production reserved capacity if contract executed within 60 days.
- Deliverables: latency baseline, two optimization runs (batching + quantization), final cost model and recommended config for production.
- Payment terms: Net30.

If everything looks good, please send PO to billing@redwood.com and I�ll route for signature. If procurement prefers quarterly invoicing or net45, let me know and we can accommodate.

Best,
Monica Patel
